# Event management

The current activity list is hard-coded and cannot be created or edited dynamically through the UI.

## Recommended Solution

- Add endpoints to create, update, and delete activities/events.
- Allow admins to manage activity details such as description, schedule, and capacity.
- Update the frontend so activities can be added or edited from a management view.

## Context

This is a common feature in club management systems and will let the app grow beyond a fixed starter dataset.
